intent.description: Map one concrete recurring employee workflow through an adaptive interview and optional supporting materials. Use when an enterprise employee wants to梳理、摸排、还原一项日常工作或重复工作，说明实际步骤、系统、材料、判断、异常、耗时与交接，并生成供本人确认的工作流程卡。Do not use for department-wide audits, consultant diagnosis, AI transformation plans, technology selection, implementation, or ordinary meeting summaries.
